title: Seaspell Sands
meta_description: Located on the largest lot in the gated community of SeaNest Village, enjoy 30A the easy way—golf cart, bikes, community pool, and a fully stocked home built for comfort.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guests Love About Seaspell Sands- GOLF CART Included- 4 Complimentary Beach Cruiser Bikes- Beach Towels Included- Rooftop Deck with Gulf Views- Spectacular 540 sq. ft. Covered Patio- Sonos System, Apple TV, Harmony Elite Remote- Quick Bike or Golf Cart Ride to Beach, Restaurants, Shopping & MoreSeaspell Sands sits on the largest lot in Seanest Village, offering privacy, outdoor living, and Gulf views in Seagrove Beach.The open living area features oversized sofas, hardwood floors, and a gas fireplace. The fully equipped kitchen includes quartz counters, double ovens, a large island, and pantry space—ideal for family meals or extended stays.The standout feature is the 540 sq ft covered loggia with outdoor living and dining areas, full summer kitchen, grill, beverage cooler, and TV.Includes golf cart, bikes, beach gear, and games. Minutes to Seaside, WaterColor, dining, and beach access.From plush robes and beach bags to a fully equipped garage with beach gear and games for all ages, every detail is curated for comfort, convenience, and entertainment. There is even an office space if you need a get away but can't get away!Ideal for family vacations, snowbirds, and 30–45 day stays.HOME LAYOUT (Sleeps 10)1st Floor- Queen Suite: Tempur-Pedic Bed & En-Suite Bath with Large Walk-In Shower- King Guest Bedroom- Shared Bathroom: Shower/Bath Combo- Bunk Room: 2 Twin/Twin Bunks (Sleeps 4)2nd Floor- Living Room: Seating for 9+ - Pull-Out Sofa (Sleeps 2)- Dining Area: Corner Table for 5-6- Chef's Kitchen: Quartz Countertops, Stainless Steel Appliances, Gas Range, & Double Oven- Center Island: Seating for 4- Half-Bath with Washer/Dryer- 540 sqft Loggia3rd Floor- Primary King Suite: Tempur-Pedic Bed, Free-Standing Tub, Dual Vanities, Oversized Walk-In Shower w/ Dual Shower Heads- Private Office SpaceOutdoor- Crow's Nest - 540 sq. ft. Covered Patio- Outdoor Living w/TV & Dining Area (Seating for 6)- Full Summer Kitchen: Gas Grill, Beverage CoolerNeighborhood Information- Located in the heart of Seagrove Beach on Scenic Highway 30A- Boutique Gated neighborhood with Stunning Community Pool- Short walk to beach access and the Gulf’s white sand beaches- Surrounded by lush landscaping for a peaceful, coastal setting- Convenient access to the 30A bike path for easy exploring- Ideally located between Seaside and WaterSound- Minutes from popular restaurants, shopping, and local attractions- Close to rare coastal dune lakes and scenic nature areas- Perfect balance of privacy and proximity to the best of 30ATDT-090900
